title: Comprehensive Test: Generators & Iterators (PY_223 to PY_228)

slides.title: Generators & Iterators Mastery Review
slides.prompt: This test evaluates your complete understanding of iterables, custom iterator classes, generator functions, generator expressions, yield from delegation, coroutine-like send/throw/close methods, and memory-efficient streaming pipelines.
slides.codeSnippet:
def gen_a():
    yield 1
    yield 2

def gen_b():
    yield from gen_a()
    yield 3

print(sum(gen_b()))  # Outputs 6
